A maker of high-performance audio equipment that designs, develops, and manufactures fully integrated digital audio systems, loudspeakers, surround sound processors, and components for music and film connoisseurs.
1. An equipment maker that builds loudspeakers, surround sound processors, and audio systems sold as finished hardware for luxury home installations.
2. Digital amplification, digital crossovers, dipole loudspeaker designs, and room correction algorithms.
3. Room correction, spatial audio processing for multiple immersive formats, and dipole sound reproduction.
4. Finished hardware products, including loudspeakers, processors, and integrated audio systems.
5. High-end home theaters, multi-room audio installations, and luxury listening rooms.
6. High-performance audio enthusiasts, music and film connoisseurs, and home entertainment integration clients.
7. Its finished audio systems are sold to consumers and installed in homes by exclusive sales agents and integration partners.
8. The company operates under the exclusive endorsement of a legendary piano manufacturer, combining that brand heritage with proprietary room correction and fully digital amplification.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Steinway & Sons, Atlantic Home Entertainment & Stereo, and International A/V Sales.
Organization type: A privately held joint venture.
Business model: Hardware sales of finished audio systems and components.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 2005, operating globally with an expanding presence in Central and South America.
Geography: Based in Denmark with sales operations in Latin America.
Beyond audio: The company focuses entirely on high-performance audio.

points.name: Streamit
points.description: Dutch audio streaming company providing business streaming solutions, audio players, and wireless audio distribution systems since 2003.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker and platform provider that designs, manufactures, and delivers business audio streaming solutions, including audio players, audio distribution platforms, and wireless audio systems for commercial use.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished hardware audio players and wireless audio distribution platforms, sold as integrated systems deployed in commercial environments.
2. The core technology comprises robust wireless audio distribution systems and playback devices designed for high-reliability commercial streaming.
3. It delivers audio playback, audio distribution, and wireless streaming capabilities.
4. Customers get the technology as finished hardware audio players and distribution platforms.
5. The systems are used in commercial business environments to create customer audio experiences.
6. It sells to businesses seeking to implement audio streaming and playback with minimal resource investment.
7. Its finished hardware and distribution platforms are deployed directly into commercial business environments as end-user systems.
8. Its approach focuses on delivering highly reliable, turnkey audio streaming hardware and platforms tailored for low-resource business deployment.
points.profile:
Organization type: It is a privately held company.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales and the delivery of audio distribution platforms.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 2003, it operates as a global provider of business audio streaming solutions.
Geography: It is based in the Netherlands and operates globally.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is on business audio streaming solutions.

points.name: Studio Technologies
points.description: US pro audio manufacturer building network intercoms and broadcast consoles for live production.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and manufactures network audio interfaces, intercom systems, announcer and talent consoles, and signal routing hardware for broadcast, stadium, corporate, and live event environments.
1. A professional audio equipment manufacturer that builds finished hardware products integrating audio-over-IP networking and signal routing, sold as standalone rack, desktop, and beltpack units.
2. Analog and digital audio signal routing integrated with Dante audio-over-Ethernet and SMPTE ST 2110 network transport protocols.
3. On-air audio control, talkback and cue routing, party-line and four-wire intercom, simultaneous language interpretation support, and microphone and line-level signal interfacing.
4. Finished hardware products including consoles, beltpacks, intercom stations, network bridges, and interface units.
5. Broadcast studios and mobile production vehicles, stadiums, eSports venues, corporate AV environments, theaters, and live event productions.
6. Broadcast networks and stations, production companies, stadium and venue operators, corporate AV departments, and government facilities.
7. Its finished hardware products are deployed directly into professional broadcast and live production workflows by audio engineers and technical directors.
8. Focuses on purpose-built announcer and talent consoles that integrate analog and digital audio resources with network audio transport in compact units.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Dante audio-over-Ethernet networking and SMPTE ST 2110 IP broadcast standards.
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: Established company with a broad product catalog shipping across multiple professional audio markets.
Geography: Based in the United States and serving professional audio and broadcast markets.
Beyond audio: Also provides video and fiber-optic transport products for the professional broadcast and production markets.

points.name: SYLVA ACOUSTIKA
points.description: Chinese audio-visual company building real-time spatial tracking systems that dynamically sync immersive sound and lighting to human movement.
points.bullets:
An audiovisual system provider that builds integrated immersive sound and lighting systems driven by real-time spatial tracking for venues and live productions.
1. A systems integrator and software developer whose immersive audio and lighting control platform runs on dedicated hardware in finished installations.
2. Ultra-wideband radio tracking combined with spatial audio rendering algorithms and show control protocols.
3. Decimeter-level real-time human tracking, wave field synthesis, distance-based amplitude panning, vector-based amplitude panning, and dynamic sound-following.
4. Finished hardware, integrated systems, and control software deployed in permanent and temporary installations.
5. Theaters, exhibitions, cultural tourism sites, live performances, sports venues, and ceremonial spaces.
6. Venue operators, production companies, and cultural tourism developers.
7. Its integrated systems are designed and installed directly into live venues and event spaces.
8. It couples decimeter-level ultra-wideband tracking with spatial audio rendering to make sound and lighting dynamically follow human movement.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Professional protocols including OSC and Art-Net.
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: System integration, hardware sales, and installation services.
Scale and maturity: A company based in China's Sound Valley.
Geography: Based in China and serving venues and productions there.
Beyond audio: It builds integrated audiovisual systems combining intelligent lighting and spatial audio.

points.name: Transound Electronics
points.description: Taiwanese acoustic component manufacturer making microphones and speakers for consumer electronics.
points.bullets:
A maker of acoustic components and integrated acoustic modules that develops and manufactures microphones, speaker drivers, and integrated acoustic modules for consumer electronics, communication, automotive, and wearable device makers.
1. A component manufacturer that builds microphones and speaker drivers sold as acoustic components integrated into customers' finished hardware products.
2. The core technology combines acoustic simulation, cavity design, and vibration modeling with high-end automated production to build electroacoustic transducer components.
3. The components deliver sound capture through microphones and sound reproduction through speaker drivers for multimedia and communication applications.
4. Customers receive finished acoustic components and integrated acoustic modules manufactured to specification for integration into their devices.
5. The components are used in consumer electronics, communication devices, gaming peripherals, automotive audio systems, and smart wearables.
6. The company sells to top international consumer electronics, audio, gaming, automotive, and smart wearable brands.
7. Its acoustic components are designed into finished hardware products by consumer electronics brands.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held electronics component manufacturer.
Business model: It makes money through the manufacture and sale of acoustic components and integrated modules.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 1990, the company operates two dedicated audio business units with R&D and production facilities in Taiwan and China.
Geography: The company is based in Taiwan and China and supports global customers.
Beyond audio: Audio is the organization's entire focus.

points.name: UandKSound
points.description: Custom installation loudspeaker brand designing mid to high-end home theatre speakers.
points.bullets:
A loudspeaker design and manufacturing company that builds mid- to high-end home theatre and custom installation loudspeakers for consumers and integrators.
1. A loudspeaker maker whose acoustic designs are sold as finished hardware for home audio installations.
2. Acoustic design and materials technologies applied to loudspeaker engineering.
3. Sound reproduction for home theatre and custom installation environments.
4. Finished loudspeaker hardware.
5. Home theatre and custom installation environments.
6. Consumers and audio brands.
7. Its finished loudspeakers are installed in home theatres by custom integrators, and its acoustic designs were previously built by other brands as ODM products.
8. Founded by acoustic design engineers with extensive experience creating original design manufacturer loudspeakers for established audio brands.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Previously delivered products for M&K, JBL, Harman Kardon, Infinity, Polk Audio and Canton.
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 2013 by a group of former ODM acoustic engineers.
Geography: Operates in the home theatre and custom installation market.

points.name: VA (CONCORD SOUND)
points.description: Audio manufacturer developing pro audio systems and line arrays for live sound.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that researches, manufactures, and sells loudspeakers and sound systems for live sound and installed applications.
1. A professional audio equipment maker whose finished hardware products run in live venues and installed spaces.
2. Loudspeaker and line array systems designed and manufactured in-house alongside acoustic testing infrastructure.
3. Sound reinforcement and audio projection for large-scale listening environments.
4. Finished hardware products.
5. Live venues and installed sound environments.
6. Audio professionals, installers, and sound reinforcement buyers.
7. Its finished hardware is deployed directly into live venues and installed sound spaces by audio professionals.
8. Vertically integrated operations combining in-house research, manufacturing, and acoustic testing chambers.
points.profile:
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: A company with 27 years of operation and advanced manufacturing facilities.
Geography: Based in and operates from regions supporting its manufacturing and sales operations.
Beyond audio: An audio manufacturer focused entirely on professional sound reinforcement hardware.

points.name: Enping Weilisi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
points.description: Chinese audio equipment manufacturer making professional amplifiers and digital effects processors.
aliases: WeiLiSi Electronic Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that develops, manufactures and sells high-end digital effects processors, professional KTV amplifiers and pure power amplifiers, and provides OEM and ODM manufacturing solutions for domestic and foreign customers.
1. An equipment maker that designs and manufactures finished professional audio hardware and digital signal processors, sold as finished products and built in its own factory.
2. Digital signal processing algorithms developed in-house for digital audio products, combined with hardware and software design for professional audio systems.
3. Digital audio effects processing, audio amplification and signal routing for professional KTV and sound reinforcement applications.
4. Finished hardware products manufactured on surface-mount technology and assembly production lines, alongside OEM and ODM manufacturing solutions.
5. Professional KTV venues, sound reinforcement systems and professional audio installations.
6. Professional audio brands, distributors and customers seeking OEM and ODM audio manufacturing solutions.
7. Its finished audio products and manufactured hardware are sold to distributors and brands serving professional audio venues and retail markets.
8. It operates its own 20,000 square meter modern factory with surface-mount technology lines and maintains 100% quality control across all production lines while offering OEM and ODM solutions.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held manufacturing enterprise.
Business model: Hardware sales of finished audio equipment and contract manufacturing fees from OEM and ODM services.
Scale and maturity: A mid-sized manufacturer founded in 2006 with a 20,000 square meter factory, ranked in the top 20% for amplifier orders in the United States market.
Geography: Based in Enping City, Guangdong Province, China, and operating in domestic and international markets including the United States.
Beyond audio: It also provides e-commerce design services for its customers.

points.name: Wisdom Audio
points.description: US luxury audio manufacturer building high-end planar magnetic loudspeakers for custom home theaters.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional and luxury audio equipment that designs, engineers and manufactures high-end loudspeaker systems and dedicated home theaters using advanced thin-film planar magnetic technology for architectural and in-room installations.
1. An equipment maker that builds loudspeakers, subwoofers, line arrays and multi-channel DSP amplifiers sold as finished hardware installed in custom architectures and dedicated listening spaces.
2. Thin-film planar magnetic drivers and regenerative transmission line subwoofer enclosures paired with finite impulse response digital signal processing amplification.
3. High-fidelity sound reproduction with controlled directivity, wide and even off-axis response, uniform sound pressure level throughout the listening space and low-frequency extension with reduced distortion.
4. Finished hardware products, including in-wall, in-ceiling, on-wall and free-standing loudspeakers, subwoofers and DSP amplifiers, available in custom sizes, colors and finishes.
5. Dedicated home theaters, multi-room audio systems, luxury residences and superyachts, including immersive Dolby Atmos configurations.
6. Custom installers, integrators, luxury homeowners and home theater enthusiasts.
7. Its finished loudspeakers and DSP amplifiers are sold through regional distributors and integration firms into custom-built residential and marine environments.
8. Large-scale line source radiating designs using curved planar magnetic drivers to maintain uniform sound pressure levels across expansive listening areas.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: LMC Arizona serves as an ordering and distribution partner for its architectural loudspeaker series.
Organization type: A privately held manufacturer operating in business since 1996.
Business model: Hardware sales of custom-built, made-to-order loudspeaker systems and dedicated theater audio equipment.
Scale and maturity: An established mid-sized manufacturer with 11 to 50 reported employees.
Geography: Based and operating in the United States, where it designs, engineers and manufactures its products.
Beyond audio: High-end loudspeaker systems and architectural audio products are the company's entire focus.

points.name: WÖLLER
points.description: Turkish audio equipment manufacturer building portable speakers with built-in microphones for studios, events, education, and outdoor use.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that builds portable speakers with built-in microphones for professionals and consumers.
1. A maker of professional and consumer audio equipment whose portable speakers are sold as finished hardware that runs standalone.
2. The organization uses advanced drivers, DSP processing and rugged enclosures in its products.
3. The company delivers microphone-enabled sound reinforcement and playback with robust, portable audio performance.
4. Customers get the products as finished hardware.
5. The devices are used in studios, events, education and outdoor environments.
6. The company sells to consumers and professionals.
7. Its finished hardware products are sold to end users through a global distributor network.
8. The organization combines rugged enclosures with built-in microphones and DSP processing in a portable form factor.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held company.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: The company has operated since 2015 from a 5,000 m² facility with a team of 22 professionals.
Geography: It is based in Turkey and is building a global distributor network.
Beyond audio: Audio is its entire focus.

points.name: XCITE Audio
points.description: Audio technology company developing invisible sound and haptic bass shaker solutions for automotive, consumer, and simulation applications.
points.bullets:
A developer and manufacturer of audio and haptic hardware and integration solutions that builds high-performance invisible sound and tactile bass products for automotive, consumer, and simulation applications.
1. A hardware developer that builds bass shaker devices and acoustic solutions, sold as finished hardware integrated into original equipment manufacturers' products.
2. Tactile bass transducers utilizing Klippel Controlled Sound technology, designed using COMSOL multiphysics acoustic simulation.
3. Physical sound reproduction, low-frequency bass generation, and haptic tactile feedback.
4. Finished hardware devices and complete integration solutions delivered from concept through series production.
5. Automotive vehicles, consumer electronics, and racing or simulation seats.
6. Original equipment manufacturers in the automotive, consumer, and simulation industries.
7. Its hardware devices are designed and integrated into finished products by original equipment manufacturers.
8. It takes ownership of integration performance from early concept and simulation through to series production to reduce development risk.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Klippel and COMSOL.
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales and integration services.
Scale and maturity: An established company with ISO-certified manufacturing facilities.
Geography: Based and operates internationally, exhibiting at integrated systems events.
Beyond audio: The organization's focus extends to haptic tactile feedback solutions in addition to audio.

points.name: XTA Electronics / MC2 Audio
points.description: UK pro audio company designing signal processors, console switchers, and amplifiers for live sound, installations, and studios.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment and amplifiers that designs and manufactures signal processors, console switchers, mic/line splitters, and amplifiers for touring, installation, studio, cinema, and high-end residential markets.
1. A professional audio equipment manufacturer that builds signal processors, splitters, and amplifiers sold as finished hardware for live sound and fixed installations.
2. Analog and digital signal processing electronics and audio amplification circuits.
3. Audio signal processing, microphone and line signal splitting, console switching, and audio power amplification.
4. Finished hardware products.
5. Touring sound systems, fixed installations, critical listening studios, cinemas, and high-end residential audio systems.
6. Touring sound professionals, installation integrators, studios, cinemas, and high-end audiophiles.
7. Its finished hardware is distributed to and deployed by audio professionals and system integrators in live and installed sound environments.
points.profile:
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Geography: Based in the UK, designing and manufacturing its products domestically.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is professional audio and amplification hardware.

points.name: Xvive USA LLC
points.description: Music gear company manufacturing wireless audio technology and effects pedals.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and manufactures wireless audio products and related music gear for musicians and audio professionals.
1. An equipment maker that designs wireless audio devices and finished hardware products.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Geography: The organization operates globally with a distributed product design team and manufacturing in China.
Beyond audio: The company focuses entirely on audio and music equipment.

points.name: YOGADA
points.description: Taiwanese audio manufacturer building high-performance microphones and headphones as an OEM and ODM partner.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that designs and manufactures professional microphones and headphones for conferencing, commercial audio, broadcast, and studio applications.
1. A manufacturer of finished audio hardware sold as physical products in commercial markets.
2. Analog transducers including electret condenser, super-cardioid condenser, dynamic, neodymium magnet, and planar magnetic drivers paired with active noise cancellation circuitry.
3. Clear voice reproduction, high-fidelity audio playback, active noise cancellation, and precision acoustic measurement.
4. Finished hardware products including headsets, headphones, boundary microphones, gooseneck microphones, and measurement microphones.
5. Conference rooms, commercial audio environments, broadcast studios, DJ mixing, studio tracking, and acoustic measurement.
6. International integrators, distributors, and global buyers.
7. Its finished audio hardware is sold through distributors and integrators into commercial and professional installations.
8. Over 35 years of OEM/ODM manufacturing experience backed by ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications with production facilities in Taiwan and China.
points.profile:
Organization type: Privately held manufacturing company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: Established over 35 years ago with a head office in Taipei and a manufacturing facility in Shenzhen.
Geography: Headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan with a facility in Shenzhen, China, serving international markets.
Beyond audio: Audio is its entire focus.

points.name: Zero-Ohm Systems
points.description: Audio equipment manufacturer building passive devices that allow multiple loudspeakers to connect in parallel without traditional transformer or impedance constraints.
points.bullets:
A manufacturer of passive audio devices that allow 20 to 40 or more loudspeakers to be connected in parallel to amplifiers without transformers, maintaining full-range sound for commercial installers.
1. A manufacturer of passive analog signal devices sold as finished hardware installed in commercial audio systems.
2. Passive analog circuits manage speaker loads and impedance to allow parallel connection of multiple loudspeakers over long cable runs without transformers.
3. The devices deliver high-capacity parallel loudspeaker connection with full-range sound, handling up to 4k or 2k watts per channel across two or four channels.
4. Customers get the devices as finished hardware products.
5. The devices are used in theme parks, hotels, stadiums, casinos and restaurants.
6. The company sells to commercial audio installers and integrators.
7. Its passive devices sit between amplifiers and loudspeakers in commercial distributed audio installations.
8. Its patented technology allows parallel connection of large numbers of speakers without the transformers, impedance constraints and cable length limitations of traditional distributed audio systems.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held company.
Geography: The company operates globally.
Beyond audio: The organization is a pure-play audio company.

points.name: BASSBOSS
points.description: US pro audio manufacturer building rugged high-performance loudspeaker systems for professional sound reinforcement.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that builds complete loudspeaker systems, including cabinets, drivers, amplification, and integrated digital signal processing, for audio professionals requiring high output and low-frequency extension.
1. A professional audio equipment manufacturer that builds fully integrated loudspeaker systems and sells them as finished hardware for live sound reinforcement applications.
2. Integrated loudspeaker system design combining custom cabinets, speaker drivers, amplification, and comprehensive audio processing in a single enclosure.
3. Studio-quality sound clarity, high-output low-frequency bass reproduction, and rugged reliability for extreme performance demands.
4. The organization delivers its products as finished hardware loudspeaker systems.
5. The loudspeaker systems are used in professional live sound environments and other settings requiring extreme audio performance.
6. The company sells its finished equipment directly to audio professionals.
7. Its finished loudspeaker systems are deployed directly by audio professionals in live sound and production environments.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held company.
Business model: The company generates revenue through the sale of finished professional audio hardware.
Scale and maturity: A notable loudspeaker manufacturer based in the United States.
Geography: The organization is based in and operates within the United States.
Beyond audio: The company's entire focus is on designing and building professional loudspeaker systems for the audio industry.

points.name: Brandenburg Labs
points.description: Audio technology company developing immersive headphone systems that reproduce sound environments naturally and enable virtual multichannel mixing.
points.bullets:
A developer of immersive audio technology that builds spatial rendering algorithms and finished headphone systems for professionals and consumers. The organization creates binaural rendering and head-tracking technology that reproduces real or virtual acoustic environments over headphones, allowing immersive formats to be mixed without physical speakers. Its first product is an advanced headphone system for professional mixing, with consumer intelligent headphones in development.
1. A maker of professional audio equipment and finished headphone hardware that integrates spatial rendering technology, sold as hardware products.
2. Spatial rendering algorithms combining low-latency head-tracking with Binaural Room Impulse Responses to synthesize virtual acoustic environments over headphones.
3. Spatial audio, binaural rendering, virtual speaker emulation for immersive formats including Atmos and MPEG-H, and acoustic environment reproduction.
4. Finished hardware products in the form of headphone systems.
5. Music studios, broadcast facilities, research institutes, universities, professional mixing environments, and consumer applications including music, gaming, film and AR/VR.
6. Music studios, broadcasters, research institutes, universities and professional audio engineers, with plans to reach everyday listeners.
7. Its finished headphone systems are used directly by professional audio engineers and will be sold to consumers.
8. Founded by the engineer known as the father of mp3, the company combines low-latency head-tracking with BRIRs to make spatial audio convincing enough to replace physical speaker setups for professional multichannel mixing.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Founded and led by Prof. Karlheinz Brandenburg.
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: A recently shipping company whose first product began shipping in early 2025.
Geography: Based in Germany.
Beyond audio: The organization focuses entirely on audio technology.

points.name: CEDAR Audio
points.description: British pro audio company developing software and hardware to clean and restore dialogue for film, broadcast, and music studios.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment and software that develops hardware and software products for digital dialogue noise suppression, spectral editing and real-time audio restoration for creators, engineers and other professionals.
1. A professional audio equipment and software maker whose noise suppression and restoration tools are sold as finished hardware units and software plug-ins that run in studio and broadcast environments.
2. Spectral editing and digital noise suppression algorithms implemented in hardware units and software plug-ins.
3. Real-time dialogue noise suppression, speech enhancement, audio restoration, spectral editing and forensic audio enhancement.
4. Finished hardware products and software plug-ins.
5. Film and television studios, live broadcast environments, recording studios, mastering suites, sound archives, theatres, live concert venues, on-location recording and forensic applications.
6. Creators, engineers and other professionals working in audio post-production, broadcast and forensic analysis.
7. Its hardware units and software plug-ins are used directly by professionals in studio, broadcast and live venue workflows.
8. The organization originated digital dialogue noise suppression and its tools are recognized with an Academy Award and an Emmy for their use in high-stakes film, broadcast and forensic workflows.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales and software licenses.
Scale and maturity: An established company with nearly four decades of experience and industry accolades.
Geography: Based in Cambridge, England, UK, with products used globally.
Beyond audio: Audio processing for forensic and surveillance applications is an extension of its core professional audio focus.

points.name: CLOUDVOCAL INTERNATIONAL CO LTD
points.description: Audio technology company making wireless microphones for studio recording and live performance.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that develops wireless audio products for recording and live performance, aiming to capture sound with high quality and usability for musicians.
1. An equipment maker that builds wireless audio products sold as finished hardware for use on stage and in the studio.
2. The equipment delivers wireless audio capture designed for high sound quality and reliable performance in live and recording settings.
3. The organization provides its technology as finished hardware products.
4. The products are used in studios and at live performance venues.
5. The company sells to musicians.
6. Its finished hardware is used directly by musicians in their recording and live performance workflows.
points.profile:
Organization type: The company is a privately held company.
Geography: The organization is based internationally and operates globally.
Beyond audio: The company focuses entirely on audio technology and has no stated activities outside of this field.

points.name: Dark Matter Audio Labs
points.description: Boutique audio company crafting custom in-ear monitors for musicians and audiophiles.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that builds custom in-ear monitors for musicians, audio engineers and audiophiles.
1. An equipment maker that designs and sells finished in-ear monitors for direct use by the listener.
2. Acoustic and audio engineering principles applied to custom-molded in-ear monitor hardware.
3. High sound quality, precision and comfort for personal monitoring and listening.
4. Finished hardware products.
5. Live stages, recording studios and personal listening environments.
6. Musicians, audio engineers and audiophiles.
7. Its finished hardware products are used directly by musicians and audio engineers.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Geography: Operates within the audio industry.
Beyond audio: Audio is the entire focus of the organization.

points.name: dBTechnologies
points.description: German pro audio manufacturer building active and passive sound reinforcement systems for live events and touring productions.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that develops and manufactures active and passive loudspeakers, subwoofers, amplifiers, controllers, digital mixers, and wireless microphone systems for live sound, touring, and installation professionals.
1. An equipment maker that designs finished active loudspeakers, passive speakers, subwoofers, rack amplifiers, and system controllers sold as hardware for sound reinforcement applications.
2. The hardware integrates neodymium drivers, Class-D amplification with internal DSP, FIR filters, and proprietary audio networking protocols for audio distribution and system control.
3. The products deliver high-SPL sound reinforcement, precise voicing, coherent tonal signature, and networked system control across various line array and point source configurations.
4. Customers receive the technology as finished physical hardware, accompanied by system configuration and control software.
5. The equipment is used in live events, touring productions, installed sound systems, and stage monitoring.
6. The company sells to live sound engineers, touring professionals, and systems integrators.
7. Its finished hardware products are deployed directly into live sound and installation environments by audio professionals.
8. The products combine proprietary networking protocols for audio distribution and control with a distinct tonal signature maintained across active and passive line array, column, and point source series.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: The company is part of the RCF Group and builds products compatible with the Dante digital audio networking standard.
Organization type: The organization is a corporate subsidiary brand.
Business model: The company generates revenue through the sale of professional audio hardware products.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 1990, the brand maintains a global presence with an extensive professional audio product portfolio.
Geography: Founded in Bologna, Italy and operating globally, the company is based in Köln, Germany.
Beyond audio: Professional audio equipment manufacturing is the entire focus of the company.

points.name: FaitalPRO
points.description: Italian professional audio brand manufacturing high-performance loudspeaker drivers for live sound and touring.
points.bullets:
A component manufacturer that designs and builds professional loudspeaker drivers, horns, and woofers for sound reinforcement system designers and professional audio engineers.
1. A maker of audio components that builds loudspeaker transducers and horns, sold as discrete physical components for integration into finished speaker enclosures.
2. Acoustic transducer designs engineered using finite element analysis, vibrometry, and acoustic simulation, utilizing ferrite and neodymium magnet materials with advanced suspension and diaphragm geometries.
3. High-power sound reproduction across low, mid, and high frequency bands, characterized by high sensitivity, large cone excursion, and thermal power handling up to 1500W continuous.
4. Finished physical speaker components, including woofers, compression drivers, and aluminum horns, sold to enclosure manufacturers.
5. Live sound reinforcement systems, touring rigs, and fixed audio installations requiring high output and reliability.
6. Professional audio system designers, loudspeaker enclosure manufacturers, and audio engineers.
7. Its transducer components are built into finished speaker enclosures by professional audio brands and integrators.
8. It vertically integrates advanced research and development simulation tools with highly automated industrial manufacturing specifically for high-power professional transducers.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Its drivers are used in enclosures built by Doyle Audio, Shermann Audio, Aura Audio, and Mode Audio.
Organization type: A brand and professional audio division of a privately held parent company.
Business model: Hardware component sales of individual loudspeaker drivers and horns.
Scale and maturity: A division of an Italian manufacturer established in 1958 with a worldwide presence in the professional audio market.
Geography: Based in Milan, Italy, with manufacturing in Italy and a global distribution footprint.
Beyond audio: The organization operates entirely within the audio technology ecosystem as a specialized professional audio division of a broader loudspeaker manufacturing parent company.

points.name: FATfrequency In-Ear Monitors
points.description: Singaporean custom in-ear monitor manufacturer handcrafting audiophile-grade earphones with pro-audio reliability for musicians.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that designs and handcrafts custom in-ear monitors, providing audiophile-grade audio solutions with pro-audio reliability for musicians.
1. An equipment maker that builds custom in-ear monitors sold as finished hardware worn by users.
2. Balanced armature and dynamic driver acoustic configurations tuned by hand.
3. High-fidelity audio reproduction, sound isolation, and frequency tuning for stage monitoring.
4. Finished hardware products custom-built for individual ear impressions.
5. Live stage performances, studio monitoring, and personal audiophile listening.

Organization type: A privately held company.
Geography: Based and operated in Singapore.

points.name: Ferrofish
points.description: German pro audio company building DANTE converters for live sound and install applications.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that builds audio converters, networking interfaces, and instrument expanders for recording studios, live sound, broadcast, post-production, and commercial installations.
1. A professional audio equipment maker that builds digital audio converters, network interfaces, and instrument expanders sold as finished hardware.
2. The company's products utilize audio analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion circuits and audio networking protocols.
3. Its products deliver high-channel-count audio conversion, Dante audio networking, and organ tone generation.
4. Customers receive the technology as finished hardware units.
5. The hardware is used in recording studios, live sound, broadcast, post-production, and commercial installations.
6. The company sells to audio professionals, broadcast facilities, and commercial installation integrators.
7. Its finished hardware products are distributed to end users by a dedicated marketing and distribution division.
8. The company provides professional-grade audio conversion and networking solutions featuring German engineering at an economic price point.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Products are marketed and distributed exclusively by Synthax.
Organization type: The organization is a privately held company.
Business model: The company makes money through hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: The company was founded by Jürgen Kindermann and Klaus Has.
Geography: The company is based in Linz, Germany.
Beyond audio: Audio hardware manufacturing is the organization's entire focus.

points.name: FEUR PRO
points.description: Audio equipment company manufacturing premium loudspeakers, mixing consoles, and amplifiers for professional sound applications.
points.bullets:
An audio equipment maker that designs and manufactures premium live sound and professional audio hardware for audiophiles and audio professionals.
1. A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and manufactures finished hardware sold to the professional audio market.
2. Analog and digital electronic components and acoustic transducers engineered for high-fidelity sound reproduction and reinforcement.
3. High-fidelity sound reinforcement, audio mixing, signal amplification, and acoustic capture.
4. Finished hardware products including speakers, mixing consoles, amplifiers, and microphones.
5. Live sound venues, professional audio installations, and studio environments.
6. Audiophiles and audio professionals.
7. Its finished hardware is deployed directly into live sound venues and professional audio setups by end users.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Beyond audio: The organization focuses entirely on professional audio equipment and high-fidelity sound solutions.

points.name: Gainlab Audio
points.description: Hungarian audio company making high-end studio outboard gear.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs, manufactures and sells high-end analog studio outboard gear, including tube compressors, tube equalizers and channel strips, for recording studios.
1. An equipment maker that builds analog outboard studio processors and sells them as finished hardware units.
2. Vacuum-tube and analog circuit topologies, including vari-mu, optical and valve compression and tube equalization.
3. Dynamic range compression, equalization and microphone preamplification for tracking and mixing.
4. Finished hardware products.
5. Recording studios.
6. Studios, engineers and musicians.
7. Its finished hardware units are purchased by recording professionals for studio use.
8. It builds high-end analog outboard gear using vacuum-tube circuitry, with products recognized in industry awards.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Sound On Sound and Music China.
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 2020, with international recognition and industry awards.
Geography: Based in Budapest, operating internationally.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is audio hardware.

points.name: Glassonic
points.description: Glass speaker company designing high-fidelity glass speakers for home and commercial use.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that designs and develops glass speakers for home and commercial use.
1. An audio equipment maker that builds glass speakers sold as finished consumer and commercial hardware.

points.name: HISONG Music Technology Inc.
points.description: Music technology company building intelligent software and hardware solutions for audio creators.
points.bullets:
An audio technology company that builds intelligent, professional-grade hardware and software solutions for music and audio creators. The organization develops finished audio products that integrate its own semiconductor applications, algorithms, acoustic engineering and industrial design.
1. An equipment maker that builds finished audio hardware and integrated software products sold to creators.
2. The company delivers intelligent audio processing and acoustic engineering capabilities for professional music creation.
3. Customers get the technology in the form of finished hardware products.
4. The products are used by music and audio creators in studio and production settings.
5. The company sells directly to music and audio creators.
6. Its finished hardware and software products are used directly by end-user creators.
7. The organization vertically integrates advanced semiconductor applications, algorithm development, acoustic engineering and industrial design into single finished products.
points.profile:
Organization type: The company is a privately held company.
Geography: The company operates with a global team.
Beyond audio: The organization focuses entirely on music technologies and products.

points.description: German audio company engineering condenser microphones and accessories for the professional audio market.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that engineers and manufactures capacitive microphones and accessories for the pro audio market. The organization provides custom-tailored measurement and recording microphones along with related industrial supplies directly for businesses.
1. An equipment maker that designs and builds capacitive sensors and microphones sold as finished hardware.
2. Capacitive sensor technology is applied to the design and engineering of its microphone products.
3. Customers receive finished hardware products and related accessories.
4. The microphones and accessories are used in professional audio applications.
5. The organization sells to businesses and distributors operating in the pro audio market.
6. Its finished microphones are distributed to businesses and end-users through direct sales partnerships.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately owned company.
Business model: It makes money through the sale of finished hardware and custom-tailored products.
Geography: The organization is based in Viernheim, Germany and Northwest, Ohio, and operates in an international market.
Beyond audio: Beyond audio, it provides businesses with manufacturing design, production process consulting, job costing and industrial supply expediting.

points.name: SICA
points.description: Italian loudspeaker manufacturer building HiFi and studio monitor drivers.
points.bullets:
A manufacturer of loudspeakers and acoustic components that designs and builds raw speaker drivers, compression drivers, and horns for audio equipment makers, instrument amplifier brands, and distribution partners.
1. An equipment maker that designs and manufactures raw loudspeaker drivers and acoustic components, selling them as physical hardware to other equipment manufacturers.
2. Electromagnetic and electrodynamic transducers using ferrite, neodymium, and alnico magnets, alongside diaphragm materials and acoustic horn waveguides.
3. Acoustic sound reproduction across high, mid, and low frequencies using compression drivers, woofers, subwoofers, coaxial speakers, and cone drivers.
4. Finished raw loudspeaker components and driver units sold to industrial customers and distribution partners.
5. Studio monitors, Hi-Fi systems, public address and sound reinforcement, musical instrument amplifiers, home cinema, and smart furniture.
6. Audio equipment brands, musical instrument amplifier makers, industrial customers, and retail distribution partners.
7. Its components are integrated into finished hardware products by audio brands and sold through retail distribution partners.
8. It combines in-house engineering, tooling, and assembly with a focused product range covering both high-end studio drivers and vintage-style musical instrument speakers.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Jensen, Fender, Mesa/Boogie, Gibson, Magnatone, Supro, Harmony, BandLab, GR Bass, and Mars Pro.
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Wholesale component sales and custom OEM driver development.
Scale and maturity: Established in 1979 with over 45 years of operation and a consolidated manufacturing facility.
Geography: Based in Trecastelli, Italy, with a global distribution network.
Beyond audio: The company focuses entirely on loudspeaker manufacturing and acoustic transducer engineering.

points.name: JoeCo
points.description: UK audio equipment manufacturer building multichannel audio recorders and playback systems for live sound and broadcast environments.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and manufactures multichannel audio recorders and playback systems for live performance, broadcast, and installation environments.
1. An equipment maker that builds standalone multichannel audio recorders and players sold as finished 1U rack-mountable hardware.
2. Multichannel audio recording and playback hardware supporting analog, AES/EBU, MADI, Dante, and SoundGrid interfaces with internal power failure recovery and metadata embedding.
3. Multitrack audio capture, multichannel playback of backing tracks and surround stems, redundant failover playback, and remote triggering via timecode, MIDI, or footswitch.
4. Finished hardware devices, companion remote control applications, and software upgrades for existing hardware.
5. Live sound tours, broadcast engineering, location recording, themed entertainment, and post-production.
6. Audio professionals, touring musicians, broadcast engineers, and location sound engineers.
7. Its finished recording and playback hardware is operated directly by audio professionals in live sound and broadcast workflows.
8. Focuses on dedicated standalone multitrack capture and playback hardware with built-in redundancy and power failure recovery to replace computer-based systems in mission-critical live environments.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Collaborated with Audinate to integrate Dante networking technology into its recorders.
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales and software option licenses.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 2007 with an established presence in the professional audio market.
Geography: Based near Cambridge, UK, and operates globally.
Beyond audio: Professional audio hardware is the company's entire focus.

points.name: Josephson Engineering
points.description: US pro audio brand manufacturing precision condenser microphones for studio recording.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that manufactures precision condenser microphones for recording studios and live sound applications. The company builds its own microphone capsules and electronics, selling finished hardware to engineers and musicians.
1. A manufacturer of professional audio equipment whose finished condenser microphones run in studios and live recording environments.
2. The microphones use FET-tube hybrid condenser designs with hand-built capsules supporting multiple polar patterns and high SPL handling.
3. The microphones deliver multi-pattern acoustic capture across omni, subcardioid, cardioid, hypercardioid and figure-8 patterns, with selectable sensitivity and sonic character modes.
4. The company provides finished microphone hardware.
5. The microphones are used in recording studios and live sound environments.
6. The company sells to recording studios, studio engineers, producers and musicians.
7. Its finished microphones are purchased directly by recording professionals for use in studio and live recording settings.
8. The company manufactures its own capsules and employs FET-tube hybrid circuit designs rather than using off-the-shelf capsule components.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: The company makes money through hardware sales of finished microphones.
Scale and maturity: The company has operated since 1988.
Geography: The company is based and manufactures in California.
Beyond audio: The company's entire focus is precision microphone hardware for professional audio.

points.name: JTS Professional Co., Ltd.
points.description: Audio equipment manufacturer designing professional microphones, wireless systems, and in-ear monitors for live sound.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and manufactures microphones, wireless microphone systems, in-ear monitoring systems, headphones, earphones, and tour-guide and conference audio products for performers, venues, and audio professionals.
1. A professional audio equipment maker that builds finished wired and wireless microphone and monitoring hardware products sold as physical units used on stage and in installations.
2. The core technology comprises acoustic transducers, RF wireless transmission systems, and audio monitoring hardware.
3. The specific audio capabilities it delivers include sound capture, wireless audio transmission, and personal monitor mixing.
4. Customers get it as finished hardware products.
5. The products are used in live sound venues, studios, conference rooms, and tour-guide settings.
6. The company sells to audio professionals, performers, installers, and venues.
7. Its finished hardware products are sold directly to end users and through professional audio distributors and retailers.
points.profile:
Organization type: The organization is a privately held company.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales.

Geography: The company is based in Taiwan and operates internationally.
Beyond audio: Audio is its entire focus.

points.name: Klangio GmbH - klang.io
points.description: Software company developing AI tools that convert audio recordings into sheet music and MIDI.
points.bullets:
An AI software developer that builds instrument-specific AI models for music transcription, providing browser-based tools and DAW plugins that convert audio recordings into sheet music, MIDI and MusicXML for musicians, composers, producers and educators.
1. An AI software developer whose audio transcription models run in the cloud behind web applications and DAW plugins.
2. Instrument-specific neural networks analyze polyphonic audio recordings to detect melody, chords, harmony and rhythm.
3. Automatic music transcription, polyphonic pitch detection, chord and harmony analysis, key and scale identification, and printed sheet music optical recognition.
4. Cloud-based web applications, DAW plugins and instrument-specific mobile or desktop apps.
5. Music studios, music education, composition and music production workflows.
6. Musicians, composers, producers and educators.
7. Its transcription software is used directly by musicians and producers in composition, education and production workflows.
8. It builds dedicated AI models optimized for the specific timbres, articulations and complexities of individual instruments rather than a single general transcription engine.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Software-as-a-service subscriptions for its web platform, DAW plugins and instrument-specific transcription applications.
Beyond audio: Its software focuses entirely on audio-to-notation conversion and does not operate outside the music transcription domain.

points.name: Kludge Audio

A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and manufactures special-purpose analog signal processing devices for 500-series racks, along with chemicals for analog tape equipment, for recording studios and audio engineers.

2. Analog audio circuits employing transformers, germanium components and phase rotation networks to process electrical audio signals.
3. Preamplification, equalization, peak limiting, level smoothing and phase rotation of audio signals.

Organization type: A privately held company.

points.name: LatencyFix
points.description: Swedish audio-tech startup eliminating signal latency in modern music production and real-time collaboration.
points.bullets:

7. Its software is used by audio professionals to synchronize signal latency in their production and collaboration workflows.
8. It enables automatic, sample-accurate synchronization rather than relying on static measurements or manual calibration.

Organization type: Privately held startup.
Business model: Software licenses or subscriptions.
Scale and maturity: Early-stage startup preparing to present its flagship technology at a major industry trade show.
Geography: Based in Sweden.

points.name: Lenbrook Media Group
points.description: Canadian audio company developing software and content distribution technologies to preserve analog sound in digital audio formats.
points.bullets:
A provider of finished audio equipment, multi-room audio software platforms, and licensed digital audio codecs and processing plug-ins, serving consumers, device makers, and music creators across the music supply chain.
1. An equipment maker and software developer that builds finished hi-fi hardware and multi-room audio management platforms, alongside digital audio codecs and software plug-ins licensed to hardware manufacturers and streaming services.
2. Audio codecs that package studio-quality audio for streaming, wireless transmission codecs that scale from lossless to lossy rates, and digital signal processing algorithms for analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion.
3. High-resolution audio encoding, multi-room audio playback management, scalable wireless audio transmission, and audio defect reduction like time smearing during conversion.
4. Finished hardware products, licensed IP and codecs, software plug-ins, and multi-room audio software platforms.
5. Home audio systems, whole-home networked audio installations, commercial audio environments, and music production studios.
6. Consumers, custom integrators, device manufacturers, hardware makers, streaming services, broadcasters, and music creators.

8. It vertically combines owned consumer audio hardware brands with proprietary multi-room software and licensed studio-grade codec technologies acquired to span the entire music supply chain from creator to listener.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Its codec technology is used by Tidal, and its multi-room platform integrates with Qobuz Connect and OraStream.
Organization type: A privately held parent company with a wholly owned subsidiary media group and multiple owned audio equipment brands.
Business model: Hardware sales, software platform licensing, and IP or codec licensing.
Scale and maturity: A privately held enterprise established in 1978 with global distribution across over 80 countries.
Geography: Based near Toronto, Canada, with global offices and distribution across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific.

A maker of professional audio equipment that develops high-channel-count PCIe sound cards for digital audio applications, selling finished hardware to professionals in studio, broadcast and live production settings.

points.name: Maxim's Group
points.description: Italian accordion manufacturer preserving historic instrument brands through modern craftsmanship.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs and handcrafts acoustic musical instruments for professional musicians, educators, and passionate players.

2. Traditional acoustic reed-based sound generation integrated into hand-built wooden chassis using selected materials and mechanical components.
3. Acoustic sound generation and expressive musical performance through hand-operated bellows, reeds, and manual controls.

8. It preserves and elevates the historic Italian accordion-making tradition of Castelfidardo while combining selected materials with advanced technical solutions to meet modern musical demands.

Key partners and customers: Renowned international artists including Richard Galliano, Pietro Adragna, Juan Villareal, and Marito Aguilar.
Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales of finished musical instruments.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 1989 and exporting instruments throughout Europe, the Americas, and Asia.
Geography: Based in Castelfidardo, Italy and operating internationally across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.
Beyond audio: The organization focuses entirely on the design, manufacture, and promotion of acoustic accordions and their associated musical culture.

points.name: Minuendo Lossless earplugs
points.description: Norwegian audio company making adjustable high-fidelity earplugs that reduce harmful sound levels without compromising musical clarity.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that builds high-fidelity earplugs for musicians, audio engineers, and live-music enthusiasts who need hearing protection in loud environments without compromising sound quality.
1. An equipment maker that builds passive acoustic hearing protection devices sold as finished hardware worn in the ear.
2. Passive acoustic filters and mechanical adjustment mechanisms that provide even attenuation across the frequency spectrum while maintaining natural tonal balance and spatial perception.
3. Adjustable broadband noise attenuation that preserves audio clarity, detail, and spatial perception while reducing harmful sound exposure.
4. Finished hardware products with ergonomic designs, multiple ear-tip sizes, and durable materials built for extended professional use.
5. Live performances, rehearsals, soundchecks, crowded venues, and touring environments.
6. Musicians, DJs, audio engineers, educators, live-music enthusiasts, and retailers.
7. Its finished earplugs are sold directly to audio professionals and through retailers for use in live sound and performance settings.
8. Adjustable attenuation allows users to instantly control noise reduction levels without removing the earplugs, enabling adaptation across changing live sound conditions.
points.profile:
Organization type: A privately held company founded by musicians and engineers.
Geography: Based in Norway, operating in the music and live sound industry.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is on hearing protection and acoustic engineering for music professionals.

points.name: MNTRA

A developer of virtual instruments and audio effects software that creates sample-based instruments and effects using experimental recording techniques and ultrasonic capture, for musicians and sound designers.

Organization type: Privately held company.

The organization develops proprietary capsule designs and solid-state circuitry that emulates the sonic behavior of classic tube microphones using modern components.
1. An equipment maker that builds boutique condenser microphones sold as finished hardware for use in studios and live recording environments.
2. The core technology consists of proprietary condenser capsules paired with solid-state analog circuit designs that emulate the sonic behavior of vacuum tubes.
3. The organization delivers finished microphone hardware products built with modern, easily available electronic parts.
4. The microphones are used in studios and recording environments by artists and engineers capturing vocal and instrumental performances.

Business model: It makes money through hardware sales of finished microphones.

4. Customers get it as finished hardware products and accompanying software applications.
5. The products are used in portable live sound setups, concert tours, open-air festivals, corporate events, and permanent outdoor installations.
6. The company sells to audio professionals, live sound engineers, rental companies, installation contractors, and event organizers.
7. Its finished hardware systems are installed in venues and deployed at events by rental companies and integration contractors.
8. Its approach is distinguished by modular, stackable loudspeaker designs integrated with network-enabled DSP control software.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Notable partners include Sama Sound, which installed the company's products for a permanent outdoor audio project.
Organization type: It is a privately held manufacturer.
Business model: It makes money through hardware sales of finished audio equipment.
Scale and maturity: The company is an established manufacturer with over 35 years of operation and advanced production facilities.
Geography: The organization is based in Germany and operates internationally, including in Europe and Asia.
Beyond audio: Its entire focus is professional audio equipment and sound reinforcement.

points.name: Alcons Audio
points.description: Dutch professional sound system manufacturer developing pro-ribbon speaker technology for studio and live event audio.
points.bullets:
A manufacturer of professional sound systems that develops and builds loudspeakers, subwoofers, amplified controllers, and stage monitors utilizing proprietary pro-ribbon transducer technology for the studio, cinema, installation, and touring industries.
1. An equipment maker that designs and manufactures finished loudspeakers, amplifiers, and controllers, sold as complete hardware systems.
2. The core technology is a patented pro-ribbon transducer design combined with Class-D amplification and DSP engines, providing high-output mid and high frequencies with fast-transient response and low distortion.
3. The systems deliver high SPL sound reinforcement, extended low-frequency reproduction, accurate sound monitoring, and spatial audio rendering for immersive environments.
4. Customers receive finished hardware products, including passive and self-powered loudspeakers, subwoofers, and amplified loudspeaker controllers with integrated DSP.
5. The products are used in cinemas, houses of worship, live sound touring, studios, corporate installations, residential home theaters, and immersive experience rooms.
6. The company sells to system designers, consultants, AV integrators, production companies, and premium residential distributors.
7. Its finished hardware systems are designed into venues and touring rigs by integrators and distributed to residential channels by cinema equipment providers.
8. The organization applies the exact same proprietary transducer, amplification, and processing technologies from studio reference monitors to large-scale sound reinforcement, maintaining a single cross-application audio reference.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Its products are distributed to cinema customers by Pulse Cinemas and are integrated with StormAudio processors.
Organization type: A privately held manufacturer.
Business model: The organization generates revenue through the sale of finished professional audio hardware, loudspeakers, and associated electronic controllers.
Scale and maturity: A European manufacturer founded in 2002 that develops and produces all products in-house.
Geography: Based in the Netherlands with a North American sales operation, operating in global professional audio markets.
Beyond audio: The organization is a pure-play audio company focused entirely on professional and residential sound reinforcement hardware.

points.name: Algo
points.description: Canadian manufacturer building IP endpoints for paging, emergency alerting, and secure door entry.
points.bullets:
An equipment maker that designs and manufactures network-based IP audio and visual communication endpoints, including IP speakers, horns, paging adapters, and intercoms, for enterprises transitioning from analog to VoIP unified communication and mass notification systems.
1. An equipment manufacturer that builds IP paging speakers, horns, visual alerters, paging adapters, and intercoms sold as finished hardware endpoints that run on enterprise local area networks.
2. Network-attached audio and visual endpoints that stream voice paging and emergency alerts over IP networks using SIP and multicast protocols, paired with analog-to-IP bridge adapters for legacy speaker integration.
3. Voice paging, public address, background music distribution, loud ringing, emergency mass notification, secure door entry intercoms, and visual alerting.
4. Finished hardware products, including IP endpoints, paging adapters, strobe lights, and endpoint supervision controllers, distributed through reseller and integration partners.
5. Offices, classrooms, hallways, warehouses, yards, manufacturing facilities, healthcare buildings, and educational campuses.
6. Enterprises, educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and manufacturing organizations requiring networked communication and alerting infrastructure.
7. Its finished hardware endpoints are sold, installed, and supported by telecommunications resellers and integration partners for enterprise unified communication and notification deployments.
8. The equipment integrates directly with unified communication platforms and mass notification systems to replace legacy analog paging infrastructure with managed network endpoints.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: Microsoft Teams, Zoom Phone, RingCentral, InformaCast, and WCC.
Organization type: A privately held telecommunications equipment manufacturing company.
Business model: Hardware sales of IP communication endpoints, visual alerting devices, paging adapters, and intercom products.
Scale and maturity: A long-established company founded in 1968 with over five decades of engineering and manufacturing experience.
Geography: Based in Burnaby, British Columbia, Canada, where it houses its engineering, technical support, and manufacturing operations, selling to organizations worldwide.
Beyond audio: The organization focuses entirely on designing and manufacturing network-based IP audio and visual communication endpoints.

points.name: AtlasIED (Mitek Communications Group)
points.description: Commercial audio company building paging, mass communication, and distributed audio systems for public spaces.
points.bullets:
A maker of commercial audio and communications equipment that designs, manufactures, and sells finished hardware and integrated systems for commercial environments. The company provides mass communication, paging, background music, sound masking, and IP-based audio and visual communications solutions for transportation, healthcare, corporate, education, government, hospitality, industrial, and house of worship markets.
1. A commercial audio equipment maker that builds finished hardware and integrated systems, sold as physical products installed in commercial facilities.
2. The core technology comprises IP-based audio networking, loudspeaker design, and signal processing for distributed audio and mass communication systems.
3. The equipment delivers mass notification, high-intelligibility paging, background music distribution, sound masking, and IP-based visual and audio communications.
4. The company provides finished hardware, loudspeakers, and complete integrated systems.
5. The products are used in transportation, healthcare, corporate, industrial, government, hospitality, education, and house of worship facilities.
6. The company sells to integrators, contractors, and facility operators outfitting commercial and institutional buildings.
7. Its finished hardware is specified and installed by commercial integrators into institutional and corporate facilities.
points.profile:
Organization type: A family-owned commercial audio equipment manufacturer.
Business model: The company makes money through hardware sales of commercial audio and communications equipment.
Scale and maturity: A long-established company in its ninetieth year of operation with nine locations and a global distribution network.
Geography: The company operates globally from its base with nine locations and a worldwide network of representatives and distributors.

points.name: Aurora Multimedia
points.description: US AV technology company building beamforming microphones and audio-visual processing hardware for integrated systems.
points.bullets:
A manufacturer of professional AV equipment that designs and builds AV-over-IP platforms, processors, and control panels with integrated beamforming microphones for AV integrators.
1. An equipment maker that builds AV processors, transceivers, touch panels, and amplifiers sold as finished hardware.
2. AV-over-IP networking, video processing, and beamforming microphone arrays integrated into control systems.
3. Beamforming microphone capture, audio distribution, video scaling and rotation, and noise-gated speech intelligibility triggering.
4. Finished hardware products, including desktop touch panels, AVoIP transceivers, test pattern generators, and PoE amplifiers.
5. Government facilities, education, security, hospitality, corporate, courtrooms, council chambers, and houses of worship.
6. AV integrators and their clients.
7. Its finished hardware is installed by integrators into commercial and institutional AV systems.
8. In-house design and manufacturing of integrated AV control and networking hardware, combining AV-over-IP and HDBaseT in single transceivers.
points.profile:
Key partners and customers: SDVoE, HDBaseT Alliance, and Dante/AES67.
Organization type: Privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: Founded in 1998 with in-house production facilities.
Geography: Based in Morganville, New Jersey, USA.

points.name: AV-LEADER Corporation
points.description: Taiwanese audio manufacturer producing professional microphones and headphones for global markets.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that manufactures microphones and headphones for professional and amateur users. It builds a range of microphone types and headphones for various sound applications. Its products are used wherever audio performance is a priority across multiple industries and settings.
1. An equipment maker that manufactures finished microphones and headphones and sells them as physical hardware.
2. Analog electroacoustic transducers in wearable housings, including single-ear, dual-ear, and splash-proof headset designs.
3. High-quality voice pick up for speech and vocal use, with hands-free operation and compatibility with wireless body pack transmitters and wired interfaces.
4. Finished hardware products with optional connectors.
5. Stages, gyms, fitness clubs, lectures, live streaming, singing, dancing, conferences, measurements, and other professional audio settings.
6. Professional and amateur users, audio distribution companies, and audio manufacturing sectors.
7. Its finished microphones and headphones are sold to end users and distribution partners globally.
8. It provides lightweight, flexible wearable microphones with specialized form factors for humid and active environments.
points.profile:

Organization type: A privately held company.
Business model: Hardware sales.
Scale and maturity: A large manufacturer founded in 1988 with over 30 years of experience.
Geography: Based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operating globally.

An equipment maker that builds wireless microphone systems designed for professional audio capture in unsupervised meeting and learning spaces.

2. Patented driver technologies and DSP amplification driving loudspeaker arrays and spatial audio systems.

A manufacturer of professional audio equipment and an OEM/ODM and contract engineering company that develops digital audio, amplification, and analog circuit products for live sound, studios, and other industries.

An equipment maker that designs and manufactures loudspeaker systems and subwoofers with integrated DSP for large-scale live venues.

3. Volumetric WaveField Reconstruction, computer-controlled 3D wavefront adaptation, multi-beam control, asymmetrical energy dispersion, and self-calibration.
4. Finished loudspeaker enclosures with integrated transducers, amplification, and DSP, accompanied by an iOS tuning and configuration app.
5. Theaters, arenas, stadiums, houses of worship, concert halls, and outdoor live event venues.
6. Live event production companies and venue operators.
7. Its loudspeaker systems are purchased and deployed by live event production companies for large-scale audience sound reinforcement.
8. Volumetric WaveField Reconstruction places sound directly in the listening area rather than projecting from the venue perimeter, improving localization and clarity as system size increases.

points.name: FBT Elettronica S.p.A.

1. An equipment maker that designs and manufactures finished professional audio hardware sold as physical products.
2. Professional loudspeaker and line array systems combining electronic design, plastic molding, carpentry, mechanical assembly and acoustic engineering within a single manufacturing facility.
3. Live sound reinforcement, portable sound reproduction and installed audio coverage using passive and powered speaker systems.

points.name: Fohhn

points.name: Harmonic Design
points.description: German pro audio brand building DSP-powered loudspeaker systems for audiophile performance.
points.bullets:
A maker of professional audio equipment that designs, engineers and manufactures premium loudspeaker systems, DSP system amplifiers and control software for installation and touring applications. The company builds integrated audio solutions combining loudspeakers, amplifiers and digital mixing in finished hardware cabinets, sold as complete professional PA systems and components.
1. An equipment maker that designs finished loudspeakers, subwoofers, DSP amplifiers and integrated PA cabinets sold as physical hardware products running the company's embedded DSP and control software.
2. Loudspeaker drivers in vented and horn-loaded enclosures paired with multichannel DSP system amplifiers using FIR filtering, 96 kHz / 32 bit and 192 kHz / 32 bit conversion, and cylindrical wavefront line-source array technology with rigging hardware.
3. High-output sound reinforcement, directional beamforming for speech intelligibility in challenging spaces, cylindrical wavefront coverage, sub-bass reproduction, multichannel amplification, FIR-based loudspeaker processing and networked remote control of amplifier parameters.
4. Finished hardware products including passive and active loudspeakers, battery-powered portable PA cabinets, floor monitors, subwoofers, multichannel system amplifiers, and companion control and simulation software for Windows and macOS.
5. Live sound touring, portable and off-grid PA, fixed installations in challenging acoustic spaces, media and collaboration rooms, and professional audio trade-show demonstrations.
6. Professional audio system integrators, touring sound companies, rental houses, installation contractors, and corporate collaboration facilities.
7. Its finished hardware products and matched system packages are sold through distribution partners and deployed by professional audio integrators and touring sound providers.
